d:
Jet black hair of short, cropped length and a neat style. Pale gray eyes with a cold, vacant expression. Appears to be in early adulthood with a neutral, androgenous face. Slender and lithe build, wearing a charcoal gray and obsidian black assassin's garb with a face-covering mask. A singular, ornate silver mask is often held or worn, concealing the features.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
